variable: air temperature at ~1.6 m (REMS ATS, estimated ambient), 5-min means
stats: per (Ls bin, LTST slot): median / p10 / p90 over the sols with data in the slot; gaps up to 1 h linearly interpolated in LTST (slotsInterpolated)
filter: AMBIENT_TEMP_CONFIDENCE_LEVEL byte 8 (reliability) = 1; strict also byte 7 (error < 5 K) != 0; outlier screen: 5-min means further than max(5 robust sigma, 10 K) from the median of the Ls bin within ±15 min dropped
